stages.sub: After this the student can explain how firms decide how many workers to hire and why that demand depends on productivity, wages and the product market.

steps.q: A bakery is deciding how many bakers to hire at the going wage rate. What are they actually working out?
steps.right: How many workers to employ at that wage
steps.wrong: How many loaves to sell that day
steps.hint: Think about what the wage rate lets the bakery decide, in terms of workers.
